name: Ola Electric

snapshot.about: Ola Electric manufactures electric two-wheelers, battery cells, and energy storage products.

narrative: Management targeted Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹500 to ₹550 crore, but reported revenue missed guidance at ₹455 crore. Auto segment revenue grew 72% sequentially to ₹455 crore with gross margins at 30.5%, matching product economics targets.

promises.statement: Management expects Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue of INR 500 to 550 crore.

said.quote: Looking ahead to Q1 FY27, we expect 40,000 to 45,000 orders and consolidated revenue of 500 to 550 crores, nearly double of the Q4 level

actual_source.source: screener.in, compiled from the company's filed results

promises.statement: Gigafactory cell installed capacity scaling to 6 GWh by March 2026.

said.quote: We are currently at 2.5 gigawatt hour install capacity, scaling to 6 gigawatt hour by March 2026

actual_source.quote: The Gigafactory is expected to be operational at 6 GWh by September, supporting greater own-cell integration in our vehicles as well as opportunities across energy storage and other applications

promises.note: Gigafactory 6 GWh capacity target missed March 2026 deadline and was deferred to September 2026.

promises.statement: Consolidated EBITDA breakeven volume lowers to approximately 15,000 units per month.

said.quote: At this level, our EBITDA breakeven reduces to approximately 15,000 units per month

actual_source.quote: With the reset OpEx base and current gross margin structure, adjusted operating EBITDA breakeven is achievable at around 20,000 to 25,000 units per month

promises.note: EBITDA breakeven target was raised to 20,000-25,000 units per month in Q4 FY26.

promises.statement: Adjusted operating EBITDA breakeven is achievable at 20,000 to 25,000 units per month.

said.quote: With the reset OpEx base and current gross margin structure, adjusted operating EBITDA breakeven is achievable at around 20,000 to 25,000 units per month

promises.statement: Gross margins are expected to stabilize in the range of 35% to 40% during FY27.

said.quote: We continue to see gross margins stabilizing in the range of 35% to 40% during the financial year 26-27

promises.statement: Auto segment annual maintenance CapEx is expected to be around INR 50 crore.

said.quote: Vipul, in Auto, on an annual basis you should expect very incremental CapEx, maybe ₹50-odd crores that's about it

promises.statement: Operating cash burn is expected to be INR 300-500 crore over FY27.

said.quote: , there will be about ₹300-₹500 crores of operating cashflow burn over the course of this year as the volumes go up.

promises.statement: Beyond the cell project, capex for the year will be around ₹30-50 crore.

said.quote: except for the Cell project that is now being completed, capex beyond that will be around ₹30-50 crore

promises.statement: Roadmap targets service revenue of ₹400-500 crore by FY 2027-28.

said.quote: with our roadmap targeting service revenue of approximately ₹400-500 crore by FY 2027-28

promises.statement: Management expects quarterly opex to reduce into the ₹300-325 crore range over the next couple of quarters.

said.quote: Over the next couple of quarters, we expect opex to come down into the ₹300-325 crore range, which is where our target is
and we expect steady state between, give or take ₹250 to ₹300 crores over the next couple of quarters
expect OpEx to move towards approximately 350 crores.

promises.statement: Gross margins are expected to remain in the 30-32% range over the next quarter or two.

said.quote: We expect margins to remain in this range over the next quarter or two and to improve further as commodity prices ease

promises.statement: Monthly OpEx is expected to come down to INR 100-120 crore over the next couple of quarters.

said.quote: And we are further saying that in the next couple of quarters, we'll actually get our OpEx down to about 100-120 crores a month; so further down while business rebounds

promises.statement: Warranty provisions for FY26 are expected in the range of 2-3%.

said.quote: the warranty provisions for the current financial year are expected in a range of 2-3%, which is among the lowest in the Indian EV industry

promises.statement: Management expects Q1 FY27 orders of 40,000 to 45,000 units.

said.quote: Looking ahead to Q1 FY27, we expect 40,000 to 45,000 orders and consolidated revenue of 500 to 550 crores

promises.statement: The Gigafactory is expected to be operational at 6 GWh by September.

said.quote: The Gigafactory is expected to be operational at 6 GWh by September, supporting greater own-cell integration in our vehicles as well as opportunities across energy storage and other applications

signals.quote: Free cash flow was negative in 5 of 5 years, −₹10,826 crore in total.

cash.read: Profits do not turn into cash. Free cash flow was negative in all five reported years, leading to a cumulative negative free cash flow of ₹10,826 crore.

bull.point: Auto revenue grew 72% sequentially to ₹455 crore in Q1 FY27, generating ₹139 crore in gross profit.

evidence.quote: Auto revenue grew 72% sequentially to ₹455 crore, with gross profit of ₹139 crore

bull.point: Auto gross margin sustained at 30.5% in Q1 FY27, reflecting underlying product economic strength despite commodity headwinds.

evidence.quote: Despite a challenging commodity environment, we sustained Auto gross margin at 30.5%, reflecting the underlying strength of our product economics

bull.point: Consolidated gross margin reached 38.5% in Q4 FY26, driving ₹91 crore in positive operating cash flow.

evidence.quote: We exited the year with industry-leading gross margins at 38.5%, a much lower cost base, sharply improved execution metrics, better product quality, our first operating cash flow positive quarter
Consolidated CFO was 91 crores, supported by strong gross margins, PLI inflows, lower OpEx and tighter working capital discipline

bear.point: Free cash flow was negative across all five reported years, resulting in a total cash drain of ₹10,826 crore.

evidence.quote: Free cash flow was negative in 5 of 5 years, −₹10,826 crore in total.
evidence.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

bear.point: Unfavourable CARO remarks were issued by statutory auditors across the holding company and three main subsidiaries for FY26.

evidence.quote: following companies incorporated in India and included in the consolidated financial statements, have unfavourable remarks, qualification or adverse remarks given by the respective auditors in their reports

bear.point: Database-level audit trail facilities were disabled for direct data changes across general ledger, revenue, payroll, and after-sales service software.

evidence.quote: the feature of recording audit trail (edit log) facility was not enabled at database level to log any direct data changes
